{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length, dropping missing values
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort to find the highest
mean_flipper_by_species = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Print the result
mean_flipper_by_species"}
